translations.web: Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
translations.bsb: Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
translations.kjv: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
translations.asv: Bless Jehovah, O my soul. O Jehovah my God, thou art very great; Thou art clothed with honor and majesty:
